name: UpCity
author: Serponge
description: Fly through the green orb at 25% while not touching it after becoming ship and then straightfly between the two spikes and saws. Fly in the middle of the screen while avoiding the speed portals 30% where you have to start navigating through the level's gameplay as the ship. Move to the ceiling at 35% after passing through all of the levels gameplay. Briefly fall down from the ceiling at 56% to land on the block in front of the cube portal and then move back up to the ceiling until 59% where you can fall to the floor. Stay on the floor until the end from there.
